tagline: Popular unofficial Minecraft launcher (RU) flagged as DANGEROUS
description: TLauncher is a proprietary Minecraft launcher of Russian origin. It supports launching various Minecraft versions, installing Forge, Fabric, OptiFine, modpacks, and custom skins, but it is closed-source and flagged as DANGEROUS due to documented security concerns and suspicious behavior.
features: Quick launch for Minecraft versions with built-in Forge, Fabric, and OptiFine setup
Built-in mods, skins, and resource pack catalog
Flagged as DANGEROUS — see video evidence in the danger report
